videos.script: Almost every model that runs in this lab started life on Hugging Face. {{title}} Whisper, pyannote, the speaker models, the Piper voices. Someone published them on the Hub, and someone else converted them to run anywhere. {{hub}} This lesson is about choosing and running models like these. The Hub's tasks, a model card, and the licence, which lives in more than one place. {{cards}} Then a measurement. The same Whisper at full precision and at a quarter of the size. Does the smaller copy make more mistakes? {{int8}} One honest note. The Hub itself was not reachable from the machine this course was recorded on. So the code that downloads from it was not run here, and the lesson says so where it appears. {{end}}
